test_title: PYST 22: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 27 Jun 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions I, II and III. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it seems to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follows from the statements.

**Statement****:**

No mug is bucket.

All mugs are cups.

Some cups are spoons.

**Conclusion:**

I. Some spoons are buckets.

II. Some mugs are spoons.

III. Some cups are not buckets.

options.text: Only conclusion I and II follow

solution:
Given Statements:

No mug is bucket.

All mugs are cups.

Some cups are spoons.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/90f84460bcc1a79408731e5430f6684109ff2c59f5a1ba785e7cb705571c0509.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some spoons are buckets - False (Because, No definite relation given between spoons and buckets).

II. Some mugs are spoons - False (Because, No definite relation given between mugs and spoons).

III. Some cups are not buckets - True (Because, those part of cups which is mugs will definitely not buckets).

So, Only conclusions III follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
